info.title: OpenELIS Global FHIR REST server
info.description: The FHIR R4 REST API OpenELIS Global serves at {server}/api/OpenELIS-Global/fhir. It reads from and writes to the OpenELIS database directly. It is not the co-resident HAPI FHIR store. See api.html.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International

contact.name: OpenELIS Global (Digital Initiatives Group, University of Washington)

/metadata.description: All FHIR Servers return a CapabilityStatement that describes what services they perform
